News Date : 30 Sep 2022News ReportIT Student Mr. Shashi Kant Upadhyay bearing roll no 16261A1248 of batch 2016-2020 has been awarded by honorable Prime Minister of our country Sri. IT Student Mr. Shashi Kant Upadhyay bearing roll no 16261A1248 of batch 2016-2020 has been awarded by honorable Prime Minister of our country Sri. Narender Modi for being the ALL INDIA BEST CADET in NAVY WING with GOLD MEDAL.
The Management of MGIT, Principal, Vice-Principal and Staff congratulate Mr. Shashikant Upadhyay for his outstanding performance and bringing laurels to the institute.
